title: Imaginary-frequency grid starts at nfreq = 16

nfreq.meaning: Number of imaginary-frequency points for the analytic continuation; the default production value is 16.

adjust.symptom: the low-energy GW gap is unstable or the Padé roots are unstable at nfreq = 16
adjust.effect: use a denser frequency grid through the convergence ladder
adjust.guard: record the ladder pair; the BN 24 vs 32 pair was bit-identical while 16/8 were off by ~0.3 eV, so a matched-definition reference may pin 24

constraints: Default production nfreq is 16; a higher value must come from a convergence ladder or a matched reference definition, never from a replay case by inheritance.
Response cost scales roughly linearly with nfreq, so an unjustified 24 wastes about 1.5x the work.

sources.ref: conversation 2026-10-23 (16 is generally enough; 24 is not the default)
